// notify.ts
export function notify(order, send) { if (order.paid) send({ to: order.email, body: 'receipt' }); }
input.test: test('paid order receives receipt', () => { const send = mock(); notify({ paid: true, email: 'a@example.test' }, send); expect(send).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ to: 'a@example.test', body: 'receipt' }); });
input.context: No hooks, helpers, mocks, imports or additional assertions are omitted.
input.contract: Order notification requirement: send a receipt to the purchaser after payment. The mock observes the boundary effect.

rationale: A mock can observe real production collaboration rather than echo its own setup.
